question.text: The DISADVANTAGE of customised benchmarks is:

answer.text: Higher cost of construction and maintenance compared to market indices

explanation.text: The Logic: Custom benchmarks match strategy but are costlier to build and maintain. The Trap: Accuracy/match are positives, not disadvantages. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Evaluate cost-benefit before committing to custom benchmark overhead.
